description.value: Gong Cha is a globally recognized bubble tea franchise with roots in Taiwan, known for premium loose-leaf teas brewed fresh every four hours and a fully customizable drink menu (tea base, toppings, sugar level, and ice level). The Langley Willoughby location sits in a retail unit at 8045 204 Street, making it a handy refreshment stop for cyclists passing through the Willoughby area. With a takeout-focused model, orders are quick and portable.

address.value: 8045 204 Street, Unit A110, Langley, BC V2Y 2A9

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: bollard (4 spaces) at 22m; bollard (6 spaces) at 41m; bollard (4 spaces) at 72m. Total: 14 spaces.
